title: Warmly Roasted Indian Lamb Biryani
description: A hearty and aromatic Indian dish featuring roasted lamb and Italian seasonings, cooked to perfection in a Dutch oven.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the lamb pieces with salt, black pepper, and Italian seasoning.
Roll out the puff pastry on a floured surface to a large rectangle.
Place the lamb pieces in the center of the pastry rectangle, leaving a 1 inch border around them.
Brush the edges of the pastry with ghee.
Fold the pastry over the lamb, pressing the edges to seal.
Place the pastry in a Dutch oven and roast for 30 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the Dutch oven and continue roasting for 20 minutes.
Add the basmati rice to the Dutch oven and stir to combine with the lamb and onion mixture.
Cover the Dutch oven with a lid and roast for an additional 20 minutes.
